steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each channel is placed by its cost per lead and whether its spend is producing leads.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 channel's cost per lead rose more than 20 percent

findings.title: Cost per lead up more than 20 percent week on week
findings.fix: Review the bids and the targeting

findings.title: Channel with spend and no leads
findings.fix: Pause the spend and check tracking

findings.title: Week with a missing channel export

outcome.notChecked: Lead quality (see `rlm-mkt-lead-quality`); attribution; sources not supplied.
